newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Graboplast to gain from E.Europe demand.
newsitem.headline: Graboplast to gain from E.Europe demand.

text.p: Hungarian home improvement product maker Graboplast is poised to benefit from demand for plastics products in central Europe, OTP Securities said in a report in which it rated Graboplast shares as "buy."

"The use of plastic products in Graboplast's target market shows potential for high growth, especially compared to the mature western European market," OTP Securities' analysts Gabor Korondan and Zoltan Nemeth said.

With the domestic market remaining slack, Graboplast's goal of expanding in eastern European markets could favourably affect profitability as the gross margin of such exports is higher than that of exports to western Europe, the report said.

"Domestic demand for Graboplast's main products shows signs of stagnation and in some cases decline," the analysts said. "On the other hand, these products have yet to tap into latent demand from central-eastern Europe," the analysts said.
The report said the group was in danger of overexpansion following recent company purchases and its current efforts to acquire a parquet floor manufacturer.
"Extensive expansion may adversely affect the company's efficiency and it may take some time for new company units to be efficiently integrated," they said.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Graboplast shares closed at 4,745 forints, down five.
